content.text: {"id":"iQBCvg8IQLSupkQb0IHv","title":"State sync from certified execution results","linkTitle":"State sync from certified results","kind":"sheet","type":"document","urls":{"app":"https://app.gitbook.com/s/pvyFEde12m2tVRjI8TRw/execution/state-sync"},"path":"execution/state-sync","slug":"state-sync","pages":[],"layout":{"cover":true,"coverMask":"none","coverSize":"full","width":"default","title":true,"description":true,"tableOfContents":true,"outline":true,"pagination":true,"metadata":true,"tags":true,"actions":true,"anchors":true},"documentId":"2wK6oDG9U56xaSm7ubSb","tags":[],"markdown":"# State sync from certified execution results **Executor may finish a range by importing a verified peer result.** When a matching certificate and usable change set arrive before local execution finishes, it can safely stop remaining work and apply that result. Executors communicate directly. Switching and storage details remain open. ## State sync from certified execution results Certified execution-result sync is an option on the **normal validator path**, not only restart or lag recovery. A validator already executing can reduce remaining work when certified results and applicable change sets become ready first. Responsibility and peer communication are adopted requirements; transition policy, material format, verification, persistence, and safety/liveness validation remain implementation work. The requirement does not force replacement of direct execution or waiting for certificates. Executor orchestrates switching; Storage owns target/material validation, canonical mutation and recovery under [the storage durability contract](/pages/BytJ0SideZZqJsRObbha#section-003). Certificate and material verification are separate, as shown below. QMDB sync-target verification does not automatically authenticate native order or execution-certificate provenance. | Stage | Verify | Pass to the next stage | | ------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------- | | Certificate | f+1 distinct eligible epoch validators on the same statement; exact native range, input state, runtime, result | Verified target statement | | Material | Delta / checkpoint / outputs match the exact local base and target commitment | Importable state material | | Storage application / recovery | Selected durable commit contract for state, outputs, cursor and provenance | Imported verified canonical checkpoint | | Subsequent execution | Direct execution / validation of the next exact range from the imported checkpoint | Next range's direct result and potential signature | The import commit contract also binds ImportedVerified provenance to canonical-checkpoint recovery. If recovery cannot restore direct-execution evidence for a range, the node cannot produce its own signature for that range. Verifying and applying imported material cannot become an own `DirectExecuted` signature. The receiver may relay or serve the original signers' certificate. It may sign the **next range** after directly executing that range from the adopted canonical base. A correctness certificate does not establish material retention, dissemination, or availability; serving and retention need separate contracts. Delta/checkpoint format, root type, signer boundary, import codec, and crash recovery remain open. ## Reuse Commonware material transport and proof validation **Reuse QMDB's authenticated operation sync; add the certified execution target and safe active-validator switch.** At the adopted native pin, `qmdb::sync::Source` serves operation batches/proofs, and `glue::stateful::db::p2p::{Actor, Mailbox}` adapts that source to generic resolver networking. Fresh source comparison found these core sync files and the P2P module identical to indexed `v2026.9.0`; the DB mutation wrappers still have version differences. Reuse these lower-level components without depending on glue Application/full actor; connect them using the selected native DB types. [Sync Source](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/sync/source.rs), [database P2P adapter](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/glue/src/stateful/db/p2p/mod.rs). | Existing component | Provides | Executor / Storage connection | | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Generic resolver + DB P2P adapter | Keyed operation/material fetch, retries and serving | Executor authorizes the exact target; Storage serves/verifies compatible material and controls retention | | QMDB sync Target/engine | Checks operations/proofs and rebuilt storage state against caller-trusted ops root/range | Bind that target to the verified execution statement, canonical base, runtime and chosen result root | | Public `qmdb::sync::sync(Config)` / `StateSyncDb::sync_db` | Reconstructs a synchronized DB from its configuration and selected target | Repeated sessions or advancing target updates reuse this engine; active-validator handoff and recoverable state/output/cursor/provenance linkage remain additional work | | `StateSyncSet::sync` | Coordinates one-time initialization with block anchor metadata | This bootstrap lifecycle is a reference, not the repeated certified-result switching contract | | Executor certificate exchange | Existing authenticated P2P and signature primitives | Full f+1 distinct eligible signatures, exact input-state chain and direct/imported provenance remain application checks | The QMDB target is an **operations root plus operation range**, not an execution certificate. Current's canonical `root()` differs from its `ops_root`; selecting Current requires verifying the chosen result commitment as well as the sync proof target. Target-update support requires strictly advancing targets on the same history. `Target::advances` only checks numeric range progress; it assumes append-only consistency rather than authenticating it. Executor/Storage must establish the same authenticated history before an update, so this is not an arbitrary branch switch. [Target](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/sync/target.rs#L9), [engine target contract](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/sync/engine.rs). **If Current is selected, reuse `current::proof::OpsRootWitness` for this root connection.** The existing DB `ops_root_witness()` supplies it, and `witness.verify::(&ops_root, &canonical_root)` checks whether the operation root belongs to the trusted Current canonical root. Its codec is already implemented. Storage verifies the witness against the result root authorized by the execution certificate; it does not need to invent another proof format. The Current sync engine deliberately leaves this check to its caller. This is a conditional recipe, not a choice of Current or a substitute for f+1/order/base verification. [Witness API](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/current/proof/mod.rs#L57), [DB witness](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/current/db.rs#L292), [sync caller obligation](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/current/sync/mod.rs#L6). **The public sync engine can be reused for repeated certified targets without Application.** `qmdb::sync::sync(Config)` returns a reconstructed DB. Its configuration accepts the existing Source and DB configuration, optional target updates, a finish request and reached-target notifications. Invoke it again for a selected target or advance compatible targets within a session; neither policy is selected here. A continuing session does not return a usable DB at every progress notification. `StateSyncDb::sync_db` publicly delegates to this same engine, independently of the Application trait. [Public entry point](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/sync/mod.rs#L41), [Config fields](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/sync/engine.rs#L99), [Public DB helper](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/glue/src/stateful/db/mod.rs#L611), [One-time set coordination](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/glue/src/stateful/db/mod.rs#L699). **Reached-target is progress, not verified import completion.** The engine reports it before syncing/reconstructing the database, checking its operations root and completing persistence. Do not stop execution, publish a usable state or acknowledge delivery on that notification. Storage must receive the completed candidate, verify the exact certificate-authorized result/output binding and recoverable canonical linkage. With target updates, retain the final target/certificate identity rather than relying on an old notification. [Notification order](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/sync/engine.rs#L724), [Rebuild, root check and persist](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/sync/engine.rs#L777). The constructor opens configured storage; it does not accept the live DB handle. Journal initialization may prune, rewind or clear those partitions. Preparing a candidate concurrently with direct execution therefore requires separate storage ownership; an exclusive same-store handoff requires a fence before mutation. Two handles pointing to the same live partitions do not provide isolation. For Current, the retained range must start at or below `sync_boundary()`; the next execution interval is not that storage-log bound. Candidate placement and switching remain open. [Journal reopen contract](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/sync/journal.rs#L23), [Current boundary](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/current/db.rs#L431). For compatible operation proofs, use the existing DB P2P Actor and its Source mailbox directly. The adapter requires `Op: Codec + Send + Clone + 'static`; using its mailbox as Source additionally requires `Sync`. Check the chosen native operation type against these bounds and adapt only that codec boundary if needed. Requests contain numeric operation size/start/count, not the trusted root or execution statement; sessions must retain compatible authenticated history and separately bind outputs/certificates. `attach_database` enqueues replacement and does not acknowledge processed serving readiness or writer handoff. The actor's local Source feedback ends after proof validation; it must not wait for result collection or canonical apply. [Adapter bounds](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/glue/src/stateful/db/p2p/actor.rs#L93), [Numeric request](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/storage/src/qmdb/sync/source.rs#L21), [Enqueued DB attachment](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/glue/src/stateful/db/p2p/mailbox.rs#L124), [Local proof feedback](https://github.com/commonwarexyz/monorepo/blob/534af0ede48affd35b2111522527547b4cc9bf72/glue/src/stateful/db/p2p/actor.rs#L275). The existing Stateful bootstrap lifecycle does not provide repeated normal-path certified-result switching. Executor continues direct work until both certificate and applicable material are ready; Storage then uses the same canonical authority as local execution. Partial local writes cannot become the base of a delta meant for another checkpoint. Root/material codecs, switch policy and storage replacement protocol remain open. "}
